messages:
jamie: Starting a focused PRD thread for Private Deploy networking scope. We need a clear launch bar for customer-managed networking (VPC and on-prem). Goal is to lock scope by EOW so product can schedule work.

vikram: +1. main tradeoff is breadth vs time-to-first-customer. Do we aim to support BGP + NAT + VPN for launch or MVP with only NAT/static egress?

elsa: Suggest phased approach: Phase 1 = customer-managed egress with static routes and documented NAT rules. Phase 2 = BGP peering, failover, and eBGP for advanced customers. That buys us time for testing.

alex-m: Agree phased. For Phase 1 we need acceptance criteria: 1) deterministic egress IP for audit logs, 2) documented handoff steps for customer network team, 3) automated e2e test that validates response paths.

maria-t: Also add: KMS integration for keys must be optional at launch but documented. And we need clear rollback playbook if routing breaks.

jamie: Draft acceptance criteria idea (quick):
- Deployable to a customer VPC with documented IAM & subnet requirements
- Egress IPs stable for 30 days across restarts (observability test)
- Canary route for 1 customer and automated traffic smoke test
- Runbook for ops with isolation steps and metrics to watch

vikram: Edge cases we must call out in PRD: overlapping CIDRs, asymmetric routing (customer replies bypass our path), MTU fragmentation causing TCP stalls, and on-prem NAT hairpinning. We should include mitigations.

elsa: For overlapping CIDRs mitigation: require customers to provide a set of non-conflicting /24s or we fall back to NAT overlay. Document requirement in onboarding checklist.

alex-m: Ops acceptance test snippet I prototyped:
```
# smoke test
curl -sS -H \"Host: example.com\" https://ingress.redwood.local/health | grep OK
# verify egress IP
curl -sS https://ifconfig.io/json | jq .ip
```

maria-t: Launch criteria proposal:
- Phase 1: internal QA + 1 pilot customer onboarded, satisfactory canary for 48h, no P0 network regressions for 7 days
- Phase 2: general availability after >3 customers and formal load testing

jamie: Questions for product prioritization: how many eng-sprints do we estimate for Phase 1? Also list dependencies: firewall rules, console onboarding flow, billing tags, telemetry.

vikram: Rough eng estimate: 3-4 sprints (networking + infra + docs) if we limit to static egress and documented handoff. BGP adds ~2 more sprints and requires more SRE time.

elsa: Need acceptance test matrix in PRD: happy path, overlapping CIDR, TTL/MTU edge, failover to backup region, and planned customer maintenance.

alex-m: Can we add a mandatory pre-launch checklist item: \"network contact provided + test VPN credentials or peering prefix\". Without that we can't onboard.

maria-t: Also legal/compliance: data path diagram and data residency notes for on-prem customers. Add to PRD.

jamie: I'll update the draft PRD with these items and attach a minimal checklist. Plan a short sync on Thursday to lock scope. Please drop any must-have items here before Wednesday EOD. :calendar: :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident template created: \"private-deploy-network-incident\" with fields: severity, customer, affected-prefixes, mitigation-steps, rollback-flag. Use `#incidents` when triggered.

vikram: One last ask: include performance SLOs in PRD (p95 tail, connection setup latency) and CPU/GPU memory impact notes for our runtime when NATting. We'll need telemetry hooks.

jamie: Noted. Adding SLOs and telemetry hooks. Thanks everyone — will post updated PRD link when ready.
